Container.Name: deepseek-harness-desktop
Container.Overview: Remote DeepSeek Harness desktop via Selkies. Backend is unauthenticated HTTP and is not host-published; access it only through a reverse proxy attached to dsh-proxy. The proxy must enforce authentication and TLS. Both containers use the user-created dsh-dind bridge; only this desktop also joins dsh-proxy. Keep the deepseek-harness-dind name unchanged. Selkies stays at UID 1000; do not override the container user or run as root.

Config.Name: Application home
Config.Description: Persistent app settings, DSH home, logs, and managed tooling.

Config.Name: Selkies basic auth disabled
Config.Description: Authentication is enforced by the reverse proxy, not this HTTP backend.

Config.Name: Selkies HTTPS disabled
Config.Description: TLS terminates at the reverse proxy; backend stays HTTP.

Config.Name: DinD endpoint
Config.Description: Private endpoint resolved by Docker DNS on dsh-dind; do not publish port 2375.
